bullets.note:
It’s great to see someone finally make this premise work! Michelle puts the work in, and it makes a big difference. The production value is excellent. Here are two recent eps to give you a taste: [I Tried Butler Academy](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nb6ZCS5dTSo) and [I Trained Like An Olympic Boxer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LZanXTAeqGc).  
​  
​[**Sinix Design**](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCUQTqWAaSzhAKRanOpes1nA)**.** Sinix has been saving my sanity, and keeping me focused, for the last few weeks of art practice. The video I’ve rewatched the most is [How to Learn Digital Painting (Beginners)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iwRa5qTnr8o). It’s not about lines, Ferriss! Shapes! Shapes! Shapes!

bullets.title: The Mandibles: A Family, 2029–2047
bullets.creator: Lionel Shriver
bullets.note: (best known for [_We Need to Talk About Kevin_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/We_Need_to_Talk_About_Kevin)) and narrated by [George Newbern](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Newbern). From the description: “With dry wit and psychological acuity, this near-future novel explores the aftershocks of an economically devastating US sovereign debt default on four generations of a once-prosperous American family. Down-to-earth and perfectly realistic in scale, this is not an over-the-top _Blade Runner_ tale. It is not science fiction.” Before committing too hard to a near-term dystopian future, however, it’s a good idea to read the predictions in [_Market Wizards: Interviews with Top Traders_](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/0135560934?ref_=dbs_m_mng_rwt_calw_thcv_0&storeType=ebooks)_,_ first published in 1989. The end has been nigh for the US for a long time, but it’s still ticking 30+ years later, albeit with some serious bugs. Special thanks to J. for both recommendations.

bullets.title: Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain
bullets.creator: Betty Edwards
bullets.note:
. This isn’t just for “artists.” This book is for anyone who’d like to be more creative and see the world with fresh eyes. Try the upside-down drawing exercise once, and it might just blow your mind. As Betty puts it in the Introduction: **“Many of my readers have intuitively understood that this book is not only about learning to draw, and it is certainly not about Art with a capital A. The true subject is** _**perception**_**. Yes, the lessons have helped many people attain the basic ability to draw, and that is a main purpose of the book. But the larger underlying purpose was always to … teach readers how to** _**see**_ **in new ways, with hopes that they would discover how to transfer perceptual skills to thinking and problem solving.”**​  
​  
​[Ed Catmull](https://tim.blog/2014/08/12/ed-catmull/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf), co-founder of Pixar, said practically the same thing in [our hour-long conversation](https://tim.blog/2014/08/12/ed-catmull/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) together. Learning how to make basic ‘art’ isn’t frivolous—it teaches you, first and foremost, how to \*see\* the life around you much more clearly. Learning even primitive drawing, which you can do in a few afternoons, will fundamentally change how you see the world. As Betty writes: **“My students’ most frequent comment after learning to draw is ‘Life seems much richer now that I am seeing more.’”** ​  
​  
I’m skeptical of the neuroscience conclusions in the book, but the metaphors and exercises are rock solid.

bullets.section: Animated adventure I’m watching to decompress
bullets.title: Wolfwalkers
bullets.note: I originally watched this with a friend’s family, several young kids included, and we all loved it. Short description: “A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.” **It has a** [**98% audience score**](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/wolfwalkers) **on Rotten Tomatoes, and you can** [**find the trailer here**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d_Z_tybgPgg)**.**
